title: CHAOS Observation Time Support V1
description: Source-declared coverage envelope for a series, dataset, or observation collection. This contract is separate from individual source-record observations and does not participate in record identity hashes.

observation_period_start.description: Source-declared inclusive start boundary in the native frequency. May be a year, year-month, date, or timezone-aware ISO-8601 instant.

observation_period_end.description: Source-declared end boundary in the native frequency. Its inclusive/exclusive meaning is declared separately by boundary_semantics.

native_frequency.description: Provider-native temporal frequency, such as annual, monthly, daily, event, or native timestamp.

boundary_semantics.description: Meaning of the declared boundaries. Defaults to SOURCE_DECLARED; callers must preserve provider semantics and must not infer boundaries from observed rows.
